privacy_and_data_audit.implication: Because past sessions strictly enforce VoxGaze Privacy Invariant #7 (never store raw webcam frames/face crops), pretrained models other than MobileOne (e.g., ResNet-34) CANNOT be retrospectively executed on past CSV recordings. Retrospective evaluation is valid for MobileOne S0 and Handcrafted Geometry only. ResNet-34 evaluation requires live camera observation trials.
